name: Garden Suite
tagline: Immersed in green, woken by birdsong
description: A spacious suite opening directly onto the garden terrace. Timber beams, hand-thrown pottery, and locally woven textiles create an atmosphere of grounded calm. The private porch is perfect for evening sundowners.

name: Canopy Room
description: Elevated on a timber platform, the Canopy Room offers treetop views and unrivalled quiet. A retreat for those who want to truly disconnect.

name: Earth Lodge
tagline: Built from the land, for the land
description: Constructed with rammed earth walls and a living roof, the Earth Lodge stays naturally cool through Ghana's dry season. The most intimate of our rooms — ideal for solo travellers or couples seeking simplicity.
